description: nhentai.net front page (listing, not a title): header nav, banner ad, "Popular Now" (div.index-popular, 5 galleries) and "New Uploads" (25 galleries) as div.gallery[data-tags] > a.cover > img.lazyload[data-src] + div.caption, pagination, ad iframes. Every card has a cover, a /g/<id>/ link and a full bracketed doujin title in its caption, so a page that looks for "a cover image near a title-like string" will be fooled. There is no h1, no #info, no entity links (/tag/x, /artist/x …) and no Pages/Uploaded rows; og:type is "website". Must be refused. Unsure: the exact Popular Now / New Uploads icon classes and the category tag ids (33174/33175) in data-tags.
